Attaching the Q3 compact I promised during yesterday's playbook huddle. I tried to keep it to one page (sheet 1) with a short risk/runway column. Key asks:

- Leadership sign-off on the three top-level objectives (growth, reliability, platform economics)

Subject: Re: Q3 Seatbelt: OKR compact draft for sign-off

Marcus — thanks for the concise version. A few inline comments on the compact:

1) Growth objective: add a leading indicator (weekly new integrations) not just commit->prod. That will help Sales and Partner teams call out momentum in QBRs.
2) Reliability objective: include a target for p95 latency on the <50-token path; ops needs that to validate the SLA wording.
3) Platform economics: the token/server-hour number looks aggressive — suggest we add a one-line mitigation (quantization pilot + batching guidance) in the runbook.

Also, request from Legal: if we're mentioning partner marketplace credits in the QBR ask (see sheet 2), include the early-commit language. I can draft a one-liner for the playbook.

If everyone is comfortable with these small edits, I'll queue it to Hannah for signoff tomorrow morning and schedule a 45-min dry run for the QBR.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
